title: Varda announcement strip
description: A full-width bright strip between the hero and the tiles: a small bold label at the top left with a bold up-right arrow at the far right, and one line of medium-weight news below in the page's navy. Flat, square, no border; the arrow nudges up-right on hover.
notes: uses the card surface (near-white in the varda theme) so it reads as a light band on a dark page
